title: 第983章 三名队友第982章 银月剑
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
天天待在宗门内，赤炎也有些厌倦了，正好借着这个机会出去逛一圈。
集合地点是五天后。
这五天时间里，林潜去了一趟幸运突破的那处山谷，赤炎也跟着去了。
只可惜，幸运似乎陷入了深层次的沉睡，对于林潜及赤炎的到来，并没有任何反应。
不过，林潜重新给阵盘替换了灵识。
才过去半个多月，阵盘上灵石的灵气已经消耗了四分之一。
按理来说，应该等灵气消耗殆尽了，再更换。
但这次外出，不知道什么时候归来，林潜直接更换了新的灵石，并且还是上品灵石。
一枚上品灵石相当于一百枚中品灵石，若没有暴力入侵，足够维持阵法数年时间。
至于这上品灵石嘛，林潜自然是从赤炎那里拿的。
它成功锻造出了真器，器峰峰主器尘子极为高兴，奖赏了赤炎一些上品灵石。
林潜外出一年多时间，阿大四人将朝阳峰打理得井然有序，林潜也给了他们一些丹阳和灵石。
这两样东西都是提升修为的必须品，让阿大四人极为感激林潜。
......
五日时光转瞬即逝。
约定之日清晨，天刚破晓，晨雾缭绕丹阳门连绵山峰。
林潜一袭朴素青衫，身姿挺拔利落，赤炎已经变成拳头大小，落在了林潜肩头，看上去像是林潜养的小宠物一般，人畜无害。
林潜走出朝阳峰，纵身一跃，落入空中，朝着丹阳门的山门疾驰而去。
山门的演武场开阔宏大，青石地面光洁肃穆，已经有早起往来的宗门弟子，络绎不绝，人声淡淡。
林潜在演武场角落，静立等候，赤炎则是眯着眼，像是还没睡醒。

并未让林潜等太久，一阵轻盈沉稳的脚步声，向着林潜所在的方向而来。
林潜抬眼望去，只见上官灼华换下了平日里的长袍，而是身着一身武者劲装，衣料紧致利落，勾勒出修长凹凸的身姿。
腰束玄铁窄带，去掉了所有繁复装饰，尽显干练飒爽。
乌发高束，露出光洁如玉的额角与绝美的五官，眉眼锐利清冷，褪去了平日待人的温润温婉，平添几分凌厉气势。
content_en:
Chi Yan was a little tired of staying in the sect every day, so he took this opportunity to go out for a walk.
The meeting point is five days later.
In the past five days, Lin Qian went to the valley where he had a lucky breakthrough, and Chi Yan also went there.
Unfortunately, Lucky seemed to have fallen into a deep slumber and had no reaction to the arrival of Lin Qian and Chi Yan.
However, Lin Qian replaced the spiritual consciousness on the formation disk.
Just over half a month has passed, and a quarter of the spiritual energy of the spiritual stones on the formation plate has been consumed.
Logically speaking, you should wait until the spiritual energy is exhausted before replacing it.
But when he went out this time, he didn't know when he would return. Lin Qian directly replaced it with a new spiritual stone, and it was still a high-grade spiritual stone.
One high-grade spiritual stone is equivalent to one hundred medium-grade spiritual stones. If there is no violent invasion, it is enough to maintain the formation for several years.
As for this high-grade spiritual stone, Lin Qian naturally got it from Chi Yan.
It successfully forged a real weapon, and the master of Qifeng Peak, Qi Chenzi, was extremely happy and rewarded Chi Yan with some high-grade spiritual stones.
Lin Qian had been out for more than a year, and the four of Ada kept Chaoyang Peak in order. Lin Qian also gave them some Danyang and Lingshi.
These two things are necessary for improving one's cultivation, which made the four of them extremely grateful to Lin Qian.
...
Five days passed quickly.
In the early morning of the agreed day, dawn had just broken, and the morning mist shrouded the mountain peaks of Danyang Gate.
Lin Qian was dressed in a simple green shirt, with a tall and neat posture. The red flame had become the size of a fist and rested on Lin Qian's shoulders. It looked like a small pet kept by Lin Qian, harmless to humans and animals.
Lin Qian walked out of Chaoyang Peak, jumped into the air, and galloped towards the Danyang Gate.
The martial arts performance field at the mountain gate is open and grand, the bluestone ground is smooth and solemn, and there are already a steady stream of sect disciples who have gotten up early to come and go, and the voices are faint.
Lin Qian stood in the corner of the martial arts arena and waited quietly, while Chi Yan squinted his eyes, as if he hadn't woken up yet.
Lin Qian was not kept waiting for too long. A burst of light and steady footsteps came towards Lin Qian's direction.
Lin Qian looked up and saw that Shangguan Zhuohua had changed out of his usual robes and was wearing a warrior's attire. The material was tight and neat, outlining his slender and concave figure.
The waist is tied with a narrow black iron belt, and all complicated decorations are removed, showing a capable and sassy look.
Her black hair was tied high, revealing her smooth jade-like forehead and beautiful facial features. Her eyebrows were sharp and cold, losing the gentleness and gentleness she usually used to treat others, adding a bit of fierce aura.
